scope: Serialize the bounded low-level AC1021+ LIGHTLIST DXF profile with exact reference-role remapping and fail-closed behavior.

schema.field_order: LIGHTLIST handle; {ACAD_REACTORS with the required ACAD_LIGHT named-object-dictionary entry pointer and any actual reactor pointers; owner-object pointer; AcDbLightList subclass; version and light count; repeated LIGHT handle and name pairs.
schema.version_floor: AC1021, matching the Autodesk 2007 DXF Reference that documents LIGHTLIST. No earlier output floor is inferred.

implementation.behavior: The low-level writer requires the ACAD_LIGHT pointer in retained ACAD_REACTORS app-data; verifies that subsequent app-data pointers match the typed reactor list; remaps the dictionary pointer, reactors, owner, object identity, and each LIGHT reference; and writes the documented order.
implementation.validation: The writer requires the declared light count to match the bounded typed list, a representable class version, nonempty safe light names, valid required handles, and resolved graph edges. Malformed/unresolved profiles fail before publication; late XDATA failure rolls back record bytes and source-identity binding.
implementation.limits: Generated transport evidence only. The dwg2dxf adapter continues to refuse retained LIGHTLIST records pending physical DWG source binding, full dictionary/LIGHT graph closure, and native lighting semantics. No support claim is promoted.

validation.inputs: Locally authored in-memory values and generated ASCII/Binary documents; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
validation.control: The focused control checks exact ASCII/Binary group order and all remapped handles with and without a reference resolver; typed readback checks the object owner, ACAD_LIGHT dictionary edge, selected reactor, LIGHT handles, and names. Unresolved dictionary/reactor/owner/LIGHT references preserve existing destination bytes. A late XDATA failure preserves bytes and identity state, and a corrected fresh-writer retry reads back the remapped identity.
validation.result: PASS: focused ASCII/Binary serializer and typed-readback control passed in normal and ASan builds; dwg2dxf rebuilt; diff whitespace check passed.
